# 7 The True Is the Good in the Way of Belief

- [dangling] "My belief in the Absolute, based on the good it does me…": "the Absolute": a technical term used as if already introduced. No earlier statement in the note says what it is.
- [dangling] "Grant that it may be true in giving me a moral holiday.": "a moral holiday": a term used as if already understood. The note never says what a moral holiday is or how the Absolute gives one.
